name: Health and Fitness MCP Servers 2026
methodology: Every latest-version entry in the official MCP Registry (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers, read page by page on 2026-10-17) whose registry name, title or description matches a health or fitness data-source term on a word boundary; the terms, and the four vendor names that also need a health or fitness word in the entry, are listed in src/data/mcpHealthServers.ts. Name, title, description, version, status, dates, packages, remotes, repository and website are copied from the registry entry unchanged; registry descriptions are the publishers' words. Two columns are DERIVED and keep their evidence: matchedTerms (the term and the field it matched in) and publisherIsVendor, which is yes only when the registry namespace is the reverse-DNS form of a domain this site cites for that vendor's developer documentation, with the reasoning in publisherEvidence. Package version, licence and publish date come from npm and PyPI for npm and PyPI packages only; packageNotFound lists package names those registries answered 404 for. Repositories were not read and no server was run.
generatedFrom: src/data/mcpHealthServers.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-mcp-health-servers.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.name: The registry name, namespace/server
fields.title: The registry title; null where the entry has none
fields.version: The latest version the registry lists
fields.status: The registry's status for that version: active, deprecated or deleted
fields.registryPublishedOn: The registry's publishedAt for that version's record, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.registryUpdatedOn: The registry's updatedAt for that version's record, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.group: The one group the server is listed under on the page
fields.dataSources: Every data source a matched term names
fields.matchedTerms: DERIVED: each matched term and the field it matched in
fields.publisherIsVendor: DERIVED: yes only when the namespace is the vendor's own domain in reverse-DNS form
fields.publisherEvidence: Why publisherIsVendor is yes; null otherwise
fields.packages: Each package as listed: registry type, identifier, pinned version, transport
fields.remotes: Each remote as listed: transport type and URL
fields.secretInputs: Names (never values) of the environment variables, headers and URL placeholders the entry marks isSecret
fields.packageLatestVersion: npm or PyPI latest version per package
fields.packageLastPublished: npm or PyPI publish date of that version per package
fields.packageLicense: The licence the npm or PyPI metadata states, per package
fields.packageNotFound: Packages npm or PyPI answered 404 for
fields.repositoryUrl: The repository URL as the entry lists it (not read)
fields.websiteUrl: The website URL as the entry lists it
fields.registryRecord: The registry API record the row was read from
fields.page: This site's row for the server
